title: To Be Sung To The Tune
subtitle: Raag Maajh · Ang 137
summary: This shabad opens with to Be Sung To The Tune Of ""Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa"". It turns the heart toward o Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace.
whyItMatters: It matters when life feels tired, drained, and worn-down because the shabad keeps exhaustion inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private momentum.
takeaway: Keep returning to this turn: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰ ਮਾਝ ਕੀ ਤਥਾ ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧  ਮਲਕ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਤਥਾ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਹੜਾ ਸੋਹੀਆ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaar maajh kee tathaa salok mahalaa pehilaa  malak mureedh tathaa cha(n)dhrahaRaa soheeaa kee dhunee gaavanee ||
lines.translation: Vaar In Maajh, And Shaloks Of The First Mehla: To Be Sung To The Tune Of ""Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa""

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaadh ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਤਿਹ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur dhaataa gur hivai ghar gur dheepak teh loi ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Giver; the Guru is the House of ice. The Guru is the Light of the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: amar padhaarath naanakaa man maaniaai sukh hoi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace. ||1||

structure: It opens by naming the condition without ornament: to Be Sung To The Tune Of ""Malik Mureed And Chandrahraa Sohee-Aa"".
The middle movement widens the correction through the Guru is the House of ice. The Guru is the Light of the three worlds.
It closes with a return you can actually keep: o Nanak, He is everlasting wealth. Place your mind's faith in Him, and you shall find peace.
